value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is a canonical 16-vertex cubic symmetric graph. The exact optimal-state geometry is motivated independently by whether a minimum propagation seed set can be moved while remaining minimum. The striking complete split is both natural and quantitative: connected optimal-state space under token jumping with sharp six-replacement diameter, but every optimal state isolated under adjacent token sliding. This adds structural information beyond a cardinality or routine example, without claiming any larger-graph consequence.
